title: Hero Infinite Render #01
bug_description:
## Symptom
Page hangs when Hero mounts.

## Your task
Fix the **Hero Infinite Render** component in the editor until the preview works correctly.


**Note:** `Hero` is a React **landing-page hero section** — the large top banner with headline/image/CTA (not a game character).

## Hint
Check whether setState is called during render instead of in an event handler.

## How to verify
Click **Run tests** — your code does not need to match the reference solution exactly.
root_cause: setState is called directly in the render body.
fix_explanation: Remove setState from render; use an event handler or useEffect with correct deps.
common_mistakes: Adding if statements without understanding the render cycle
Removing state the UI still needs

title: Hero Stale Props #02
bug_description:
## Symptom
Subtitle does not update when the prop changes.

## Your task
Fix the **Hero Stale Props** component in the editor until the preview works correctly.


**Note:** `Hero` is a React **landing-page hero section** — the large top banner with headline/image/CTA (not a game character).

## Hint
Check whether state from props updates when the parent sends a new prop.

## How to verify
Click **Run tests** — your code does not need to match the reference solution exactly.

Removing state the UI still needs
